autonomy_models.warning: These are different scales on different objects. Never render one as a position on the other, and never compare them.

staleness_note: This file deliberately carries no timestamp: a clock here would make every sync commit a file whose only change is the time. Read `generated_at` from `.colaberry/manifest.json` and label it "last changed", not "last checked".

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Discovering and proving the gap is agent work. Deciding what each agent is permitted to write is an authority decision, and switching enforcement on will refuse writes that currently work, so both stay human.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The pipeline publishes machine-written content to a real audience with no human in the loop today. Generation and ingestion can be automated; publication to an audience is a human decision until a pre-publication review exists, so shadow mode is the ceiling.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Authority content is a Colaberry point of view published under the brand. Generation can be automated; the decision to say it in public cannot be, until a manager explicitly authorises a class of content. Shadow mode is the honest ceiling.
A pure, deterministic source scan with no write and no outbound action, whose whole purpose is to keep a statutory rule continuously true. Operational ownership is the correct destination.

Monitoring mentions is a read. It is capped at a supervised pilot because a mention feed shapes how the brand is understood internally, and an incomplete scan presented as share of voice would mislead in a way nobody downstream can detect.

Resolution is a validation step with a clear refusal path. It can be owned for reporting integrity; assigning a brand to a campaign is an ownership decision a human makes, so the agent's role stops at resolving and reporting.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Running the check can be automated. Authoring or publishing a brand's rules is a statement about what Colaberry will claim in public and stays a human act, so the agent's ceiling is shadow mode against rules a human published.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Binding a named person's social identity to a brand's publishing path is a consent decision by that person, not an operation. The agent's useful role is explaining what each network needs and reporting the result; the connecting stays human.

Reading and reporting brand readiness is safe. Changing what a brand is, or which domain it owns, is a business-identity decision, so write access stays human and the ceiling stops short of unattended ownership.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: This is the only path in the domain that can put brand content on a live network under a real person's profile. The platform's own HITL rule makes a public social post always require a human yes. Shadow mode is the ceiling; each provider's move to direct publishing needs its own manager authorisation, not a general one.

Session healing is internal infrastructure recovery with no content and no outbound message. It is the clearest candidate in the domain for genuine operational ownership, provided credential replacement stays a human action.

Reporting is read-only and already gated on a registry that forbids unregistered figures. It is held below full ownership because several money metrics on the same surfaces are still computed from a hardcoded price constant, so the capability cannot yet claim every number it renders is measured.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Approving a campaign authorises outbound contact with real people. An agent must never hold that decision, and the approval ladder currently has a bypass, so the agent's ceiling is preparing and submitting on an explicit human request.

Read-only by contract with tenant partitioning, bounded queries and a test suite that asserts the absence of writes. Two runs over unchanged data leave the database byte-identical, so there is no side effect to make idempotent and operational ownership is the natural destination.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Connecting an account binds a real person's social identity to the platform's publishing path, and the credential is a secret. The agent's share of this is reading health only; the connect, rotate and revoke actions stay with a named human at every level.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: This is a one-to-one message to a named human under the Colaberry identity, sent today with no approval gate and no manager-visible surface. Until a gate and a surface exist, the honest ceiling is stateful sandbox work; any production send stays a human decision.

A credentialed headless browser acting inside a third-party community is a terms-of-service surface, not just a read. It is capped at a separately approved supervised pilot because the account being driven is a real Colaberry identity and a scraping block would be visible to the community, not only to us.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The approval decision is the human gate the rest of the domain depends on; an agent that could approve its own content would dissolve every other control. The agent may prepare and request; deciding stays human at every level, so the ceiling is stateful sandbox work on the request side only.

Composing is fully reversible: an item stays a draft until a separate approval and a separate publish act on it. A scoped automation class is therefore reachable for drafting, and the two gates downstream are what keep it safe.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: A dry run is safe and repeatable. The execute step writes customer content history at scale and depends on a calendar-to-brand mapping that is a business decision, so it stays a human action; the ceiling is stateful sandbox work.

A proposal with an enforced single-table write and no send path is about as contained as an agent action gets. A scoped automation class is reachable; the proposal remains a proposal, and acceptance stays human.

A deterministic check against a single registry, with no write and no outbound action, whose failure mode is a false block rather than a publish. Operational ownership is appropriate once registry freshness is itself monitored.

Deriving drafts is reversible and every derived item still passes the existing approval gate, so a scoped automation class is reachable. Authoring the templates is brand work and stays with the manager.

Drafting a follow-up is reversible and the queue is human-approved before anything is posted. The ceiling stays below full ownership because the cadence rules decide how often a real person is contacted, and no manager has set them.

Monitoring reads public replies and writes internal rows; nothing is sent. Ownership stops short of R8/R9 because three of the highest-value platforms are manual-entry only, so the agent cannot claim complete coverage of its own domain.

Scoring writes internal rows about enrolled learners and sends nothing; the no-send guard is enforced at build time for this directory, not just documented. Full ownership waits on the scores actually driving something, which is a separate unbuilt epic.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The decisions are about contacting real learners. The capability is already in shadow mode with executed false and a build-enforced no-send guard, which is exactly what autonomy:R5 describes. Moving to execution is a separate authorisation per channel, not a promotion of this capability.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Minting the package is fully automatable and is the point of the design. Publishing it and asserting that it was published are both human acts, so the agent's ceiling is producing and tracking packages in a sandbox-provable way.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Nine streams of machine-written content reach a real audience with no editorial gate, and one of them puts words in the mouths of named real people. Collection and generation can be automated; publication cannot be, so shadow mode is the ceiling and the quote stream should arguably never leave it.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Building the hold-and-queue mechanism is implementation work. The review decision is editorial judgement about what the brand publishes to its own students, and attribution of words to real people is exactly the kind of claim no model should clear, so the decision stays human.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Drafting and previewing can be automated. Putting a page on a public Colaberry domain is a published claim about the business, and the generator has a recorded history of inventing copy nobody wrote, so publication stays a human decision and the ceiling is shadow mode.

A pointer projection with a proven-idempotent upsert, no body duplication, no decision and a build-enforced inability to send. This is the clearest candidate in the inherited set for genuine operational ownership.

The capability deliberately ends at a draft a human pastes, which is the whole reason it is safe. It can reach a scoped automation class for watching and drafting; it must never acquire a posting action, because LinkedIn comments are declared human-execution.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The suggestions include connection requests and direct messages to named individuals. Suggesting is safe; executing is a one-to-one approach under a real person's identity and stays a human action. The ceiling is stateful sandbox work until the gate is rebuilt.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Rendering and previewing is safe and useful. Delivery is a real send and the schedule is not timezone-safe, so both the subscription decision and the send stay human until the prerequisite exists.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Management is the human's side of the relationship by definition. The agent may read and obey its own directives and explain its own state; authoring a restriction, setting a goal or approving a memory is the manager's act at every level.

The calendar is a read surface over content and job state. An agent can own keeping it accurate and explaining it; choosing what goes on it is planning work that stays with the manager, and scheduling is timezone-unsafe for anyone outside Central.

Proposing initiatives is reversible, but each one creates tickets that consume other people's time, and no resolver can close them - an unattended proposer with no terminal state accumulates permanent open work. A supervised pilot with a human accepting each initiative is the honest ceiling.

A read-only surface whose governing discipline is already 'never render a number you cannot stand behind', with the trust judgement separated from the I/O and tested against an injected oracle. Operational ownership of accuracy is the right destination.

The useful agent role here is reading reports and spotting patterns across them. Submitting one sends live mail, which is a denied capability for an agent, so the ceiling is answering from stored reports.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Finding and documenting an untrustworthy metric is exactly what an agent should do unprompted. Deciding what the business's revenue definition is, and therefore which dashboards are wrong, is a governance decision for the accountable humans.

Attribution is read-only and its coverage limit is already reported rather than hidden. Full ownership waits on identity coverage being good enough that the answer describes the campaign rather than a subset of it.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Consent is the one thing in this domain that must never be inferred, relaxed or automated. The agent may read the suppression state and refuse to act on it; recording or changing a consent state stays human, and the ceiling is answering from approved knowledge.

Attribution writes rows that executives read as performance. Because the click side is spoofable and the opportunity figure is a pipeline marker rather than cash, this is capped at a supervised production pilot until the money definition is settled by marketing.revenue_and_cost_metric_truthing.

A read-only assembly of limits the modules already declare, whose failure mode is understating confidence. It is the one proposed capability whose whole purpose is to make the rest of the domain honest, so operational ownership is appropriate.
A read-only, write-nothing computation whose output is advice to a human. It can safely reach a scoped automation class; it never needs more, because the human is the actor.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The gap itself is a defect an agent can diagnose and fix in a sandbox with a protective test. The approval it restores is the human decision the whole domain rests on, so the agent never acquires that decision at any level.

Capture and scoring write internal records only. The ceiling stops below full ownership because these records feed a channel that can send real mail, and the placeholder-address design makes a downstream mistake cheap to make and expensive to discover.

Deriving a learning is read-only aggregation. It is held at a scoped automation class because the loop silently steers where the scanner looks, and until an applied/approved marker is actually read, nobody can audit which learning changed behaviour.

Verification is a read followed by an internal flag. The ceiling sits below full ownership because coverage exists for only two platforms, so the capability cannot honestly claim to verify the estate.

A deterministic gate with no LLM and no outbound action is exactly the kind of check that should eventually run unattended. It is held below full ownership while one of its two implementations (Skool) still converts its own score into a publish authorisation, which is a different and much larger claim than scoring.

This is internal queue mechanics with no outbound side effect, an existing circuit breaker and an existing rate limiter - the one capability in this domain whose whole purpose is reliable operation, monitoring and recovery, so R9 is the right destination rather than a stretch.

This is a pure safety control computed from existing rows, with no content and no outbound action of its own. Operational ownership is the point of it, so R9 is the destination rather than a concession.

Drafting itself is reversible and internal, so a scoped automation class is defensible. It stops short of full ownership because the same module currently also mints a posting task on one code path, and until that is split the capability cannot claim it only drafts.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Publishing under the Colaberry name on a third-party platform is irreversible in practice and visible to strangers. The platform's own HITL rule already makes a public social post always require a human yes (agentAutonomy.ts:123). The ceiling is therefore shadow mode; R6 and above would each need a separate, explicit manager authorisation per platform.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Submission makes legal and factual representations on the company's behalf and is already an explicit hard stop for automation. Preparing and fact-checking the package is genuinely useful agent work; submitting is not, at any level.
Reading public release notes and writing an internal note has no blast radius. It is capped below full ownership because a watcher with no staleness alarm cannot honestly claim it is still watching.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: This is the manager's own job: deciding what the brand says and when. An agent can help inventory, map and explain; the plan and the mapping are human decisions, so the ceiling is answering from approved knowledge.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Retrying a job can cause a real publication, and marking a handoff complete asserts something happened in the world. The agent may diagnose and explain; the actions that change external reality or assert it stay human.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Composing the report is safe and is the clearest DA task to hand over. Delivering it sends real mail, which is a denied capability, so delivery stays a human-initiated or separately-authorised send and the agent's ceiling is producing and previewing.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Tracing and proposing is good agent work. What revenue means is a business definition spanning Finance and Executive, and changing it changes what every dashboard asserts, so the definition stays a human decision.

Triage produces an internal verdict and a queued task; nothing is published by this step. Full ownership is withheld until the thresholds are manager-set policy rather than code constants, because a threshold change silently changes how much brand exposure the pipeline generates.

Discovery only reads public data and writes an internal signal table; no content leaves the system, so a scoped automation class is reachable. R8/R9 withheld because the scan hands work to a publication chain that is itself human-gated, and ownership of keyword policy has never been reviewed by the manager.

Minting a link and flagging untagged traffic are low-blast-radius and reversible. Full ownership waits on the two gaps the module names itself - no link health check and no persisting create path - because a capability cannot own what it does not yet do.

authority_rule.rule: A capability approved above autonomy:R2 with no granted tools is forced back down to autonomy:R2, with the reason no_tool_grants. Tool grants are the throttle.
authority_rule.note: When this binds nothing, say so in words. It means no capability in this domain has been approved above autonomy:R2 yet, not that the rule is absent or that the panel failed.

governance.disclosure: A filed request grants nothing. Status is what a named human decided, and a pending row means nobody has decided yet.

verification.disclosure: A criterion counts as passing when it is marked in `.colaberry/progress.json` in this repository. The verifier reads that file on every sync and records what it found. A story showing 0 of N is not a rejection: nothing has been claimed yet.
